Preconditions: Tester can sign in to /login with an active staff account.
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Open /app without a view query.
Expected Result: The Overview page loads with the heading Today at the corner and the Overview navigation item selected.

Preconditions: At least one appointment exists for today's Manila date or the database has no appointments.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review the Appointments metric card.
Expected Result: The Appointments metric shows the count of appointments scheduled for today in Manila.

Preconditions: There are confirmed and/or non-confirmed appointments for today's Manila date.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review the Confirmed metric card.
Expected Result: The Confirmed metric shows only today's appointments with confirmed status.

Preconditions: At least one client exists or the database is empty.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review the Clients metric card.
Expected Result: The Clients metric shows the total stored customer records.

Scenario: Collected revenue is hidden for piercers
Preconditions: Tester is signed in with a piercer role.
Expected Result: The Collected revenue metric is not shown to piercers.

Scenario: Collected revenue is shown for management
Preconditions: At least one completed sale exists today or the database has no completed sales.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review the Collected metric card.
Expected Result: The Collected metric is shown and totals today's completed sales after adjustments.

Preconditions: At least one visible appointment exists for today's Manila date.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Find the Today's appointments panel. 3. Review an appointment row.
Expected Result: Each row shows start time, end time, client initials, client name, services, reference, piercer or Unassigned, station or No station, and status.

Scenario: Empty state appears when no appointments exist today
Preconditions: No appointments exist for today's Manila date.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Find the Today's appointments panel.
Expected Result: The panel shows No appointments today with explanatory empty-state text.

Preconditions: A requested appointment exists for today's Manila date.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Find the requested appointment row. 3. Review action controls.
Expected Result: Management users can see available booking action controls for requested bookings.

Scenario: Piercer cannot manage requested or confirmed bookings from overview
Preconditions: A requested or confirmed appointment exists for today's Manila date.
Steps: 1. Sign in as a piercer. 2. Open /app. 3. Review the appointment row actions.
Expected Result: Piercer users do not receive management-only booking controls.

Scenario: Business hours readiness reflects setup state
Preconditions: Business hours may be configured or empty.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review Studio readiness. 3. Check Business hours row.
Expected Result: Business hours shows Configured when schedule data exists and Needs setup when it does not.

Scenario: Active services readiness reflects setup state
Preconditions: Services may be active or inactive.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review Studio readiness. 3. Check Active services row.
Expected Result: Active services shows Configured when at least one service is active and Needs setup otherwise.

Preconditions: A piercer may or may not be active and assigned to services.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review Studio readiness. 3. Check Qualified staff row.
Expected Result: Qualified staff shows Configured only when an active piercer has a service assignment.

Scenario: Email delivery readiness is hidden for piercers
Preconditions: Tester is signed in with a piercer role.
Expected Result: Email deliveries readiness is not shown to piercers.

Scenario: Email delivery readiness shows pending or failed attention
Preconditions: At least one notification delivery is pending or failed, or no pending/failed delivery exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Review Studio readiness. 3. Check Email deliveries row.
Expected Result: The row shows All clear when there are no pending or failed deliveries, otherwise it shows the count needing attention.

Scenario: Overview remains usable on mobile width
Preconditions: Browser dev tools or mobile device is available.
Steps: 1. Open /app. 2. Resize viewport to mobile width. 3. Review metric cards and panels.
Expected Result: Metric cards, appointment rows, and readiness rows remain readable without overlapping text or unusable controls.
